messages:
Arjun: quick ops thread — finalizing reg page and greenroom checklist. need owners for consent copy, hubspot mapping, zoom fallback, and replay CTA.
Lexi: I'll own Zoom + backups. cloud rec + local host + OBS->s3. will run RTMP smoke test 30m prior.
Vera: I'll map HubSpot + flows. fields: email, name, company, role, timezone, marketing_consent, benchmark_opt_in. will create static list webinar:inference-may2026.
Omar: I'll prepare announcement copy + 3 clip scripts (15s/60s/120s). want first clip live within 36h.
LegalBot: Consent guidance: explicit opt-in. propose: "I consent to follow-up emails and short highlight clips for marketing purposes." include privacy link. For EU, add: "I consent to processing my data per the Privacy Policy." separate checkbox optional.
Arjun: replay CTA: "Request a live demo" + gated PDF. clicking demo should create HubSpot task assigned to SDR based on region.
Vera: Handoff rules: Hot = attended + demo click or benchmark_opt_in -> create task (priority); Warm = attended & interaction -> tag for SDR nurture; Cold = registered only -> drip.
Lexi: runbook snippet: start cloud recording, start local host recording, start OBS RTMP-> s3/webinars/tmp, run 10s caption sync test. if cloud fails, upload local recording and run speech->text (whisper-large).
Omar: clips: add small overlay CTA linking to meeting link. also include a short captioned version for social.
Arjun: timeline: event Thu 11am PT. raw assets in bucket within 3h, clips draft 24h, first clip live 36h, replay email within 4h. agree?
Vera: confirm. will build workflows and test with staging contact.
ZoomBot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.us/recording/xyz987 (status: processing)
Lexi: will verify SRT when processing completes and move files to marketing/webinars/may-2026/ then ping for clipping.
Arjun: Legal signoff expected EOD Tue. Vera, ensure consent properties stored with timestamp. thanks all :rocket:
